The first way to support the game Back on January 13, 2026, update 0.0.9 of our browser prototype added subscriptions. Payments went through Stripe, and premium status showed in one place in the interface. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

A quest window worth opening Back on January 12, 2026, update 0.0.8 of our browser prototype polished the quest system. Smoother quest features, cleaner visuals, and per-player logging so we could chase bugs faster. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

The day pilots stopped flying alone Back in January 2026, update 0.0.7 of our browser prototype added clans. Create one, join one, manage it, and compete with other clans on the leaderboards. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

Your own base, running while you fly Back in January 2026, update 0.0.6 of our browser prototype added Skylab. You managed modules, produced resources and toggled module power. Assembly for crafting came in the same update. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

Before SpaceCorps 2027, there was a browser game Back on January 11, 2026, update 0.0.5 of our browser prototype laid the foundation. Ship combat against players and aliens, portal jumps, a minimap, quests, a shop and a drag-and-drop hangar. Eight months later we rebuilt it as a native game. Free on Steam, link in bio.
